  "reasons": [
    "Under NCERT Class 12 Accountancy (Section 1.6.2), money received from shareholders towards calls not yet made is termed 'Calls in Advance'.",
    "It is credited to Calls in Advance A/c and treated as a liability until adjusted against the call when it becomes due."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Share Capital",
  "syllabus_topic": "Calls in advance",

    {
      "condition": "The amount paid represents an advance towards calls not yet made by the directors.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Calls received in advance are credited to Calls in Advance Account and treated as a liability until the call falls due.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": ["E1.1"]
    }
  ],

    {

      "strongest_reading": "The company directly credits paid-up share capital for any money received from shareholders.",

      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "The advance payment is credited to Calls in Arrears Account to reduce outstanding dues.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "The uncalled receipt is treated as capital reserve and credited to Securities Premium Reserve.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,

    }
  ],

  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Credit it to Share Capital A/c immediately and treat it as part of owners' equity",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "Advance call money is not part of share capital until calls fall due."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Credit it to Calls in Arrears A/c and show it as an asset of the company",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "The call has not been made, so it cannot be Calls in Arrears."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "Matches the textbook treatment for calls received before being called."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Credit it to Securities Premium Reserve A/c as a capital reserve of the company",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "Call in advance is a liability, not securities premium."
    }
  ]
